title: Acquire closure in the directions demanded by the output
statement: For a three-atom feature a=0 with probability 8/9 and a=+-3/2 each 1/18, under every tilt exp(wa) put u=cosh(3w/2)/8>=1/8. Var_nu_w(a)=(9/4)(u+1/64)/(1+u)^2 and 4/7-Var=(4/7)(u-31/32)^2/(1+u)^2. Hence sup_w Var=4/7<1, attained at w=+-(2/3)arcosh(31/4). Pinning b=1_{a!=0}=1, probability 1/9, yields variance 9/4>1 at w=0. Feature-image-tilt uniformity alone therefore does NOT survive arbitrary constraints. The quantum construction uses stronger EVERY-longitudinal-field uniformity including pin directions; its finite-space limit remains valid. This is an exact interface counterexample, not a failure of that stronger theorem.

Exact or budgeted positive one-spin cyclic transfer evaluation and sampling, independent uniform-word and arithmetic contract, exact support/zero handling. Whole spin paths are conditionally independent only after Gaussian conditioning.

Thermal preparation requires compatible pins, potential-outside symmetric product, a genuine fixed random tape simultaneously good for all coherent prefixes, amplified statistical AND numerical precision, reversible counting and actual gates.
